body:
## Fix

F1. Clear selected preview when Show All/ownership/catalog changes remove that card from the displayed collection.
F2. Cache card-code membership per list change, using constant-time Set.has on selection. Parent review caught an O(n) hover scan in initial implementation; revised fix preserves no-database-rewalk behavior.
F3. Regressions cover filter hiding, hover/click/focus bounded work, catalog removal/re-addition, retained selection, and ownership invalidation.

## Validation

V1. Original component regression proved hidden card preview persisted before fix. Separate performance regressions failed initial fix with 2,002 code reads; final component suite passes 14/14.
V2. Parent inspected and reran production CollectionScreen in isolated real Chromium: 2 tests passed. Show All interaction clears tile and preview. 14,794-card catalog early/late hover now reads 3/3 codes, versus original implementation's 4/29,588.
V3. Worker related STORY suite: 62 files, 701 tests passed. Boundaries/data-cy: 87 tests passed.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed. Parent reviewed revised reactive dependencies and test assertions; no remaining blocker.

## Limits

L1. Membership rebuild/storage is O(n) when list changes, not on hover. Same-code metadata replacement is unchanged existing behavior.
L2. Chromium harness mounts production component with controlled fixtures; full selected-content/bootstrap remains independently blocked by existing ASSET_RECOVERY_REQUIRED fixture state. No recovery guard or shared data changed.
L3. Full local repository/browser suites not run. Browser evidence stays local; tracked component regressions included. CI remains separate.
title: fix(story): clear filtered previews without rescanning on hover
